name: The Quiet Horizon
description: A contemplative expressionist study where silence, earth tones, and evening light gather into a deeply personal horizon.

name: Northern Silence
description: A raw, atmospheric landscape shaped by cold air, emotional depth, and the stillness of open space.

name: Inner Light
description: A meditative portrait rendered in layered pigment, where calm expression and spiritual stillness lead the composition.

name: Moonlit Thread
description: An intimate night study where moonlight, motion, and emotional rhythm thread together in a softly luminous field.

name: Star Memory
description: A poetic nocturne blending memory, texture, and color to evoke wonder, longing, and quiet reverie.

name: Tide of Memory
description: A folk-inspired Madhubani art that turns symbolic motion into a story of continuity, rhythm, and living tradition.

name: Peacock in Bloom
description: Inspired by the Madhubani tradition, this work celebrates color, abundance, and mythic grace through intricate ornament.

name: Passage of Light
description: A large-scale mural study exploring movement through architectural space, warmth, and the emotional quality of light.

name: Under the Saffron Sky
description: A mural concept rooted in story, shelter, and everyday rituals, translated into color-rich architectural language.

name: Sunline
description: A radiant mural composition built from warmth, optimism, and movement, designed to transform a wall into a living story.

name: Divine Grace
description: A devotional expressionist work celebrating sacred rhythm, inner calm, and the luminous energy of divine form.
